545:t_000:26.en:
$$宗介$$
「Something good must have happened to him.」

545:t_001:0.en:
$$宗介$$
「Is that you, $$クルツ$$? What do you need that calls for a private channel?」

545:t_001:1.en:
$$クルツ$$
「I wanted to pick up our conversation from the other day before the operation.」

545:t_001:2.en:
$$宗介$$
「All right. I'll ask $n and the others to give us some privacy.」

545:t_001:3.en:
$$クルツ$$
「...Still... you... didn't seem very surprised.」

545:t_001:5.en:
$$クルツ$$
「You didn't look it at all.」

545:t_001:6.en:
$$宗介$$
「I didn't really know what expression to make when you told me something like that.」

545:t_001:7.en:
$$クルツ$$
「You haven't changed there. I thought everything with $$カナメ$$ would've helped you make some progress.」

545:t_001:9.en:
$$クルツ$$
「But... Sis won't say 'I love you.' She absolutely refuses to say it.」

545:t_001:10.en:
$$クルツ$$
「What do you think that means?」

545:t_001:11.en:
$$宗介$$
「It probably means she doesn't love you.」

545:t_001:13.en:
$$宗介$$
「You're asking the wrong person in the first place.」

545:t_001:14.en:
$$クルツ$$
「...Well, you're right. But I don't have anyone else to talk to. $$マオ$$ told me not to tell a soul.」

545:t_001:17.en:
$$クルツ$$
「We shouldn't keep secrets within the team...」

545:t_001:20.en:
$$クルツ$$
「I'm counting on you to take care of $$テッサ$$.」

545:t_001:21.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'm counting on you for backup.」

545:t_002:3.en:
$$テッサ$$
「$$ウェーバー$$ is special to you, $$相良$$, just as $$メリッサ$$ is to me.」

545:t_002:5.en:
$$モニカ$$
「We have enemy contacts at twelve o'clock! We believe they're $$アマルガム$$!」

545:t_002:6.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Then, Captain $$テスタロッサ$$...」

545:t_002:7.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Yes. I'm counting on you to handle the rest.」

545:t_003:1.en:
$$カレン$$
「$$レナード・テスタロッサ$$ is here!」

545:t_003:2.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「So he was still alive after all.」

545:t_003:3.en:
$$レナード$$
「Of course I was. It's too soon for me to croak.」

545:t_003:5.en:
$$レナード$$
「$$相良宗介$$ isn't here...?」

545:t_003:6.en:
$$レナード$$
「If she thinks she's outwitted me with this, $$テレサ$$ is an utterly hopeless fool.」

545:t_003:8.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「We don't know the circumstances, but he is clearly more aggressive than before.」

545:t_003:9.en:
$$レナード$$
「It doesn't matter. After I finish you off, I'll head to $$ヤムスク１１$$ too.」

545:t_003:11.en:
$$アルト$$
「If we shoot you down here, we can stop $$アマルガム$$ too...!」

545:t_003:12.en:
$$桂$$
「I'd feel bad doing it in front of Captain $$テスタロッサ$$, but now I can cut loose.」

545:t_003:13.en:
$$レナード$$
「You're full of spirit, $$特異点$$.」

545:t_003:14.en:
$$桂$$
「So you know about me too. It's tough being so handsome.」

545:t_003:15.en:
$$レナード$$
「Of course I do. Your existence was an important factor for me too.」

545:t_003:16.en:
$$桂$$
「I'd expect that from someone trying to build $$時空震動弾$$s. You have an unusual eye for things.」

545:t_003:17.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Our target is $$レナード・テスタロッサ$$! We'll stop him here and end this battle!」

545:t_003:18.en:
$$レナード$$
「Go ahead and try, if you can.」

545:t_003:19.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I'm counting on you, $$クルツ$$. Here's our chance to try that plan!」

545:t_003:20.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「This time, I'll let you and the $$妖精の目$$ take the glory, $$クルツ$$.」

545:t_003:21.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Leave it to me! I'm invincible right now!」

545:t_004:0.en:
$$レナード$$
「You're quite good. I'll give you that.」

545:t_004:1.en:
$$桂$$
「That smug attitude of yours... isn't very charming.」

545:t_005:0.en:
$$レナード$$
「Are you trying to lure me in, $$特異点$$?」

545:t_006:0.en:
$$桂$$
(So far, everything is going according to plan.)

545:t_006:1.en:
$$オルソン$$
(Just as we thought, that man... is very proud.)

545:t_006:2.en:
$$クロウ$$
(He's unusually aggressive today, and $$桂$$'s existence is irritating him... Luck is entirely on our side.)

545:t_006:4.en:
$$レナード$$
「Did you think that scurrying machine could shake off my $$ベリアル$$?」

545:t_006:5.en:
$$桂$$
「I won't deny it, but unfortunately for you, I don't know how to run away.」

545:t_006:7.en:
$$レナード$$
「I welcome it, $$特異点$$! You've handed me the chance to erase your existence!」

545:t_007:1.en:
$$桂$$
「Damn! I guess taking on a $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$ machine head-on was asking too much!」

545:t_007:2.en:
$$オルソン$$
「But his attention is focused on us!」

545:t_007:3.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I'm leaving the rest to you, $$クルツ$$!」

545:t_007:6.en:
$$クルツ$$
「You're too slow! With the $$妖精の目$$, I can see right through your machine's field!」

545:t_007:7.en:
$$クルツ$$
「I'll finish you with one shot from outside your awareness!」

545:t_009:1.en:
$$ルカ$$
「That's impossible! They pierced an AS with a single shot from completely outside radar range!」

545:t_009:2.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「It's a sniper! And one with godlike skills!」
